design.decision: Bid 8 only when you can make it. Unlike the bid-trigger version, a set gives nothing, though it isn't amplified either.
design.opponent: Shown at scoring on a made 8. Opponents defending a big contract also deny this multiplier.
design.rationale: This is the common +mult rung of the make-8 line, which today has only rare seeds. It differs from seed-bid8-mult by paying only on a make, which tests whether safe or risky high-bid multipliers play better.
design.draftText: +15 contract multiplier if your team makes a contract of 8 or more

critic.concerns: Trigger-only near-duplicate of seed-bid8-mult and category near-duplicate of seed-make8-x; a useful safe-versus-risky comparison.

history.note: draft-common: the enumerator also produced this signature (e-make8-mult); credited to both sources.
